title: Ethical and social risks of harm from Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Measurement of harmful stereotypes and unfair discrimination, specifically anti-Muslim and antisemitic biases, in language models.
findings: The paper reports that large language models perpetuate harmful stereotypes and unfair discrimination based on religion. Specifically, it cites findings that GPT-3 exhibits significant anti-Muslim bias (associating Muslims with terrorism) and antisemitic bias (associating Jewish people with money). Other models like GPT-2, BERT, ROBERTA, and XLNET were also found to reproduce strong stereotypical associations related to religion, as measured by benchmarks like StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs.
